svg.aria-label: mcp-phase-gate, open-source MCP server in TypeScript and Node.js. It makes an AI agent work in 5 gated phases and document each one before touching code. 1,400+ tests on Linux, Windows and macOS, 0 path escapes in 273 attack cases, v4.0.0 on npm with provenance, 13 MCP tools.
